arithmetic_contract: Inherited exact-input binary64 contract, polynomial tanh/log, outward scalar/critic arithmetic and global state-error propagation. Paired future values accumulate only production differences and a factored terminal quadratic difference. Every unknown exact sample is enclosed before confidence construction; numerical radii are not population bounds.

confirmation.future_law: For each 128-row batch, two independent full standard-Gaussian innovation arrays and their exact negatives. Every endpoint pair uses the identical array, all future clipping is odd at +/-10. No row reuses an innovation from another row. Disjoint source-bound SHA256 purpose domains separate prefix and future paths.
confirmation.node_law: One independent uniform K in {0,...,2047} for every independent candidate occupation path; no U is required for the paired scalar endpoint estimator.
confirmation.seed_derivation: root uint64 from SHA256(namespace+'/d'+str(d)+'/s'+str(stream)+'/confirmation')[:8]; purpose uint64 from SHA256('NBO-R16-signed-purpose-v1/'+str(root)+'/'+purpose)[:8]; big endian, no retry

initial_state_population.weights: uniform over nine profiles as in R12

design.seed_scope: Complete original finite distribution of sixteen selected NBO streams, all enumerated without retraining or reselection.

economic_decision.endpoint: L_G minus shared-prefix representation, finite-reference holding deficit, and the unchanged full continuous-payoff transfer.
economic_decision.interpretation: Positive G certifies the returned NBO policy occupation Bellman account. It does not establish lower critic risk than Raw or uniquely attribute the algorithm gain to learned continuation.

failure_policy.fallback: All 32 original selected policies are fitted NBO policies; any change of their recorded identity is a completeness failure.
failure_policy.missing_or_failed_policy: Fail completeness and retain all available evidence; no replacement seed, retraining, omitted stream or adaptive sample increase.
failure_policy.rerun: Only workflow attempt one may create confirmation. No existing evidence path or branch can be overwritten.
failure_policy.unfavorable_outcome: All signs retained; a favorable gain is not a publication gate.

freeze_scope: All original policy identities, design, new bank mapping, signed proof/range, numerical code, six statistical events and precision are committed before any new confirmatory bank.

inference.allocation: Two dimensions times three pooled two-sided intervals, event alpha .01/6; every event is reported and no alpha is recycled.
inference.method: Maurer-Pontil independent nonidentically distributed empirical Bernstein, log(4/event_alpha); interval sample mean/SD perturbations, frozen per-stream clipping intervals and averaged tails.
inference.scope: Standalone fresh R16 family conditional on all prior fitting, selection and observations. New signed mechanism intervals do not reuse old confidence probability.

statistic_definitions.C: M-G, signed continuation error of the predicted advantage, retaining negative observations.
statistic_definitions.G: N times stage difference plus common-noise antithetic reference-continuation payoff difference. The fitted continuation cancels before clipping and inference.
statistic_definitions.M: N times scalar approximate-Q advantage at the two actual action endpoints.

work_scope: Additional fresh mechanism assessment work, from launch through imports, original weight reload, constants, prefix and paired future paths, interval accounts and durable I/O. Historical fitting/stopping work is unchanged.
